Rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
A large iron gate separates the small zoo from the rest of the city. 
You can hear the sounds of exotic animals from behind the walls of the
zoo, along with the odors characteristic of such a park.  Inside the zoo
you will find not only the exotic creatures native to this world, but many
informative exhibits to help you get acquainted with your new
surroundings.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
As you enter the lovely little zoo, you notice a large wooden building
before you.  A small shaded path leads through the zoo to the east.  You
see a large sign posted on one of the trees along the path, perhaps you
should look at it!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
*******************************************************

*         Welcome to the Newbie Zoo!                  *
*                                                     *
*     This Zoo is full of interesting animals         *

*                                                     *

#rPlease note that not all features of the zoo are currently working!#N

Rooms.Name: Along the Shaded Path in the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The shaded path is quiet except for the exotic animals and children's
voices.  The characteristic smell of the zoo is strangely enticing as you
move further into the zoo.

Rooms.Name: The Three-way Intersection on the Shaded Path
Rooms.Description:
The shady path branches off to the south here.  You may may continue to
the east or west, but most of the action in zoo seems to be taking place
to the south of here.

Rooms.Name: The Shaded Path through the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The shaded path continues along the east and west here.  The chirping
birds mingled with the roars of nearby animals creates a melodious chorus
of nature.  Children can be heard somewhere nearby, squealing with delight
as they see strange and exotic animals for the first time.

Rooms.Name: The Shaded Path through the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The east-west path meanders through the shady zoo here.  You can hear
the sounds of animals somewhere to the south, and the air carries their
strange odors right to your nose.

Rooms.Name: The Shaded Path through the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The shady path is covered with bird droppings here.  As you gaze up
into the trees, you can see a small nest high above.  Frantic chirps
emanate from the nest, and a pair of small birds begin to dive at you. 
They must have a nest full of babies, so you should probably leave them
alone.

Rooms.Name: The Information Station at the Bend in the Path
Rooms.Description:
A small table is set up here with various pamphlets and maps placed
upon it.  A light breeze rustles through the papers at this bend in the
shaded path.  The path continues to the west and south.

Rooms.Name: The Information Room
Rooms.Description:
This room is filled with information about Midgaard and the Newbie Zoo. 
Two large maps cover the west wall, one of Midgaard and one of the zoo.  A
table sits in the corner covered with several pamphlets.  The main
corridor of the Education Building lies to the east.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Newbie Zoo Education Building
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large hallway that runs through the center of the
Education Building.  Small rooms lie to the east and west, both of which
are full of important newbie Education materials!

Rooms.Name: The Newbie Board Room
Rooms.Description:
This room contains a bulletin board full of information for newbies. 
You may post questions and problems on the board, and just read it for
answers to questions you may have that have already been asked.

Rooms.Name: Another Three-way Intersection
Rooms.Description:
You are at the intersection of two paths.  A small gravel path leads
further into the zoo to the east, and the wider dirt path continues to the
north and south.

Rooms.Name: A Path Through the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The gravel path is covered with discarded popcorn boxes and candy
wrappers.  It looks like the groundskeepers haven't been doing their jobs
too well here lately!

Rooms.Name: A Path Through the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The gravel path continues to the east and west.  Just east of here you
see a large stone building.  You hear strange sounds coming from within
the building.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Small Mammal House
Rooms.Description:
The gravel path runs east and west outside of a large stone building. 
The gray stones of the building lend to it a cold and dark appearance. 
You can feel warm humid air coming from the doorway however, and the
sounds coming from inside let you know that many animals can be found
within.  A small metal sign is hanging next to the doorway.

Rooms.Name: Another Three-way Intersection
Rooms.Description:
The gravel path intersects here with a wider dirt path.  Tall shady
trees line the eastern side of the dirt path, and you can barely see the
outline of a large stone wall behind them.  The dirt path continues to the
north and south while the gravel path continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Newbie Training Room
Rooms.Description:
The newbie training facilities have been provided to you as a service
of the Save the Newbies Fund.  They have provided a master instructor to
help you find your way to enlightenment.  You may practice any of your
skills in this room with this great instructor.  Simply type "practice" to
see what skills and spells you can practice, then "practice <skill/spell>"
to practice them.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Newbie Zoo Education Building
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large hallway that leads down the middle of the Education
Building.  The walls are covered with murals painted by the children of
Midgaard.  Rooms lie to the east and west, full of educational facilities
for you as a newbie.  Take advantage of them while you can!

Rooms.Name: The Newbie First-Aid Station
Rooms.Description:
Most people have to pay for the services of a healer, but here at the
Newbie Zoo, one is provided for free!  You should probably rest here for a
little while before you venture back out into the zoo... we don't want to
have to scrape anyone off of the buildings!

Rooms.Name: A Path Through the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
You are on a wide dirt path that runs to the north and south.  Through
the trees to the west, you can see a large building.  You hear some
strange whoops coming from the south, and you can smell the strong odors
of several large animals.

Rooms.Name: The Pygmy Marmoset Enclosure
Rooms.Description:
The eastern wall of this room is made of a strange, clear material. 
You can see several people pointing and waving at you on the other side. 
Several small trees fill up the room, and you can hear strange noises
coming from above.  perhaps some small animals are hiding in here!

Rooms.Name: Inside the Small Mammal House
Rooms.Description:
The smell in this building is nearly unbearable.  The zookeepers must
not have cleaned it out yet today.  You can hear strange squeaks coming
from behind a large, clear wall to the west.  On the other side of the
wall you see several large trees.  A small door is cut into the wall,
barely large enough for you to pass through, if you can even open it.

Exits.Description: A small door has been cut in the glass, allowing entry to the room within.

Rooms.Name: A Path Through the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The north-south path is rather serene here.  You can hear the distant
voices of the animals, but for some reason they are not so evident on this
part of the path.

Rooms.Name: The Snack Shop
Rooms.Description:
The Newbie Zoo staff has thought of everything!  They figured you would
need a place to stop and eat on your tour, so they provided a snack shop! 
The best thing about this shop is that everything is free!  Just help
yourself to the food sitting on the counter.

Rooms.Name: The Director's Reception
Rooms.Description:
This is where the Director of the Newbie Zoo welcomes all patrons.  A
large podium stands here for the director to stand behind while he gives
you a brief history of the Newbie Zoo, as well as an informative lecture
on the areas surrounding Midgaard.  The Director can also answer some
questions, such as what routes you should follow to find the animal
houses.  Just stand here long enough and he'll talk your ear off!

Rooms.Name: The Souvenir Shop
Rooms.Description:
Here in the Newbie Zoo Souvenir Shop, you can find low-cost,
comfortable Zoo attire.  All proceeds from this shop go toward providing
the many services to newbies in the zoo.  To see what you can buy, type
"list."  Then just buy the item you would like by typing "buy <item>." 
You can also help yourself to the many free samples that have been left
here.

Rooms.Name: A Path Through the Newbie Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The path runs north and south here, The trees to the west slightly
obscure a large building.  To the south you can see another large building
down the path.  Strange sounds seem to be coming from within it.  A
shorter distance to the south is the entrance to a dark building.  You can
hear an occasional roar coming from within.

Rooms.Name: The Tiger Cage
Rooms.Description:
You are inside a large metal cage.  The zookeepers have filled the cage
with large plants.  You can hear the footsteps of some large animal
somewhere inside the cage.  You better watch out, or you may get eaten!

Rooms.Name: The Golden Lion Tamarin Enclosure
Rooms.Description:
The warm humid room is filled with many tall trees.  A large clear
window opens up into the room to the east.  You see several people outside
the window looking in at you.  A small door is cut into the window leading
to the room.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Small Mammal House
Rooms.Description:
As you continue into the small mammal house, you come upon another wall
of the same clear material.  Behind the wall you see a room full of trees,
and some small furry animals.  A small door is cut into the wall, through
which you may gain entry to the room within.  The small mammal house also
extends to the north.

Exits.Description: A small door is cut in the glass.

Rooms.Name: A Path Through the Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The path continues through the zoo here.  To the west is a large black
building.  This part of the zoo is much more quiet for some reason.  The
path continues to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: The Mata Mata Tank
Rooms.Description:
The large tank is full of warm, murky water.  You have a hard time
seeing what might lie beneath the surface of the water.  You feel small
fish swimming between your legs, at least you hope they are fish!  You can
climb out of the tank to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Gila Monster's Enclosure
Rooms.Description:
The sandstone floor of this dry room is bare but for a few small cacti. 
A large bright lantern warms the entire room.  The wall to the south is
transparent, allowing you to see the adjacent room.  A small door has been
cut into the wall for passage in and out of the room.

Rooms.Name: A Path Through the Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The north-south path is bordered by trees on the west, and the outside
wall of a large stone building to the east.  You can hear menacing roars
coming from within the building, and even stranger sounds coming from the
building further to the south.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Dark Building
Rooms.Description:
The rooms don't seem to get any brighter as you move further into the
building.  Two large cages are inside of this room.  One lies to the
north, filled with several large plants that seem to be hiding a rather
large animal inside.  The other cage lies to the east.  You can see a set
of large eyes reflecting your light back at you from behind the bars.

Rooms.Name: The Lion's Den
Rooms.Description:
The floor of this dark cage is covered with tall dry grasses.  The
smell of blood overwhelms your senses and makes you quite nauseous.  The
hair on the back of your neck stands on end as you feel the movement of a
large body just behind you.

Rooms.Name: The Kiwi's Hiding Place
Rooms.Description:
This dark room is home to the elusive kiwi.  He only comes out at
night, so in order to see him, please try not to shine any bright lights
his way.  A large black curtain separates this room from the rest of the
bird house to the south.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Reptile House
Rooms.Description:
A large obsidian building stands east of the dirt path here.  A large
sign over the door informs you that you have reached the reptile house. 
The Newbie Zoo is famous for its collection of rare and exotic reptiles,
so you should most definitely take a look inside.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Reptile House
Rooms.Description:
The large Newbie Zoo Reptile House is home to several interesting
reptile species.  A large glass tank lies to the north, filled with
brownish water.  The building continues to the east, and you can exit to
the west.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Reptile House
Rooms.Description:
The Reptile House is home to several rare species of large lizards. 
Behind the large transparent walls to the north and south you can see the
rooms of two such lizards.  The komodo dragon's pit lies to the south, and
the gila monsters enclosure lies to the north.  You may enter the rooms
through the small doors that have been cut into the walls.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Menacing Building
Rooms.Description:
You are outside of a large stone building.  Menacing roars can be heard
from within.  The building looks dark and frightening inside.  The path
continues further to the north and south.  A large gray building lies at
the end of the path a short distance to the south.

Rooms.Name: A Dark Room
Rooms.Description:
The building is dark and menacing.  You have an incredible urge to turn
around and walk back through the entrance.  The loud roars coming from
within definitely do not help calm your feels at all.  You can venture
further into the building to the north, or leave for the path to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Bird House
Rooms.Description:
The collection of birds at the Newbie Zoo is housed in this spacious
aviary.  The tall glass ceiling allows you to see the sky above the zoo. 
Most of the birds housed here are flightless to maintain their residency
within this building.  The birds are free to roam about the room.  That
combined with the lush tropical foliage makes you feel as if you have
entered a sort of avian paradise.  A small room lies to the north of the
aviary.  A thick black curtain hides your view of what lies inside.

Rooms.Name: A Path Through the Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The path passes between two buildings here.  To the west is a small
building made of greenish stone.  To the east is a larger building made of
an obsidian material.  The path continues to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: The Komodo Dragon's Pit
Rooms.Description:
As you climb into the large pit, you feel a warm blast of humid air.  A
large burrow leads deeper into the room, but it is too small for you to
enter.  You can exit the pit through the small door on the north wall.  As
you look towards the exit, you see looks of horror on the faces of the
people in the adjacent room.  Perhaps you should turn around...slowly.

Rooms.Name: Another Three-way Intersection
Rooms.Description:
The three-way intersection appears to be well-worn, as if many visitors
have traveled to this part of the zoo.  A large gray building lies a short
way down the path to the south, and a large menacing building of stone
lies a short way to the north.

Rooms.Name: On the Path Outside the Souvenir Shop
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues to the east and west here.  A small wooden
building lies just south of the path.  You can see several articles of
clothing displayed in a small case next to the doorway.

Rooms.Name: A Path Through the Zoo
Rooms.Description:
The small dirt path continues to the east and west.  The exotic animal
chorus that you have heard on your visit here accompanies you on your
passage.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Bird House
Rooms.Description:
A small building made of greenish stones stands just north of the dirt
path.  You hear birds chirping and singing from within.  The path
continues to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Snack Shop
Rooms.Description:
At the bend in the dirt path, you find yourself enticed by the smell of
the snack shop to the south.  Fresh buttered popcorn and delicious roasted
hot-dogs are almost begging you to come in for a bite.  The path continues
on its merry way through the zoo to the north and west.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Ape House
Rooms.Description:
A large gray building stands just south of here at the path's end.  The
sounds of many strange animals can be heard within.  Loud whoops and hoots
pique your interest as to what creatures abide within.  As you approach
the building you notice the large sign that hangs above the door informing
you that this is the Ape House.

Rooms.Name: The Souvenir Shop
Rooms.Description:
The souvenir shop is always stocked with all of your zoo-going needs. 
Small stuffed animals are piled high on a shelf which sits next to a table
containing a display of reading materials on various types of animals. 
Behind the display case containing various animal artifacts is a young man
who can help you with your selections.

Rooms.Name: The Snack Shop
Rooms.Description:
The snack shop at the Newbie Zoo is always free!  The Save the Newbies
Foundation funds parts of the zoo to provide visitors with many different
services.  Just help yourself to the food and beverages.  If you would
like to have something added to the menu, please contact the management or
an information aide!

Rooms.Name: A Tree-filled Room
Rooms.Description:
This rather large room is filled with all types of tall trees.  The
many branches are perfect for swinging and climbing.  The east wall of the
room is made of a clear material, allowing you to see into the adjacent
room.  A small door has been cut into the clear wall allowing access to
the room outside.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Ape House
Rooms.Description:
The Newbie Zoo Ape House was named by a former zoo director who wasn't
very well versed in the terminology of primates.  The building is home to
several species of not only apes, but other primates as well.  The walls
to the east and west afford spectacular views of the animals in the
adjacent rooms.  The Ape House also continues further to the south.

Rooms.Name: Tucker's Room
Rooms.Description:
This room is filled with large blocks of wood and chewed up leather
hats.  Ropes hang from the large tree-like structure in the center of the
room.  Piles of straw are scattered about the room, some of them covered
with pieces of burlap.  A large clear wall dominates the west side of the
room.  A small metal door is set into the clear wall to allow access to
the room outside.

Rooms.Name: The Monkey Room
Rooms.Description:
A large tree-like structure stands in the middle of the room.  The
ceiling here is made of glass, allowing a lovely view of the sky above. 
The clear eastern wall allows you to see into the room adjacent to this
one.  A small door is cut into the wall.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Ape House
Rooms.Description:
The large room is surrounded on three sides by clear walls.  On the
other side of each of the walls you can see the habitats of various large
primate species.  This building houses a very interesting collection of
ape and monkey species.

Rooms.Name: A Tree-filled Room
Rooms.Description:
This is another tree-filled room.  Like all of the other rooms, one
wall (the west wall) is made of a clear material allowing visitors to see
inside, and allowing the animals to see out.  A small door is cut into the
wall allowing access to the room outside.

Rooms.Name: Katu's Room
Rooms.Description:
This spacious room is filled with several large pieces of soft
furniture.  A small bed made of straw has been placed in one corner of the
room.  Several pieces of paper covered with bright paints are pasted to
the walls of this room.  A large clear wall stands to the north allowing
the occupant of this room to see the people outside.  A small metal door
has been placed in the wall.

Mobs.Name: zookeeper chrissy christine
Mobs.LongDescription: Christine the Zookeeper is standing here feeding the animals.
Mobs.Description:
Christine the Zookeeper loves her job!  She gets to work with all of the
interesting animals of the New Mavernal Zoo every day.  Her hair is a
mess, and she doesn't smell too great, but that is OK for the job she has
to do.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote reeks like the animals she works with.;%10 smile

Mobs.Name: danno zookeeper dan
Mobs.LongDescription: Danno the Zookeeper is standing here cleaning out cages.
Mobs.Description:
Danno the Zookeeper has a very diffucult job ahead of him.  He gets to
 clean up after all of the animals in the zoo!  The zookeeper does't smell
 too sweet, but he doesn't seem to mind.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote points to the mess you are leaving.;%10 sigh;%10 say I wish
 people would learn to clean up after themselves!  The animals are bad
 enough as it is.

Mobs.Name: gorilla male katu
Mobs.LongDescription: A large male gorilla sits here pondering his existence.
Mobs.Description:
The large silverback meets your gaze with an eerily intelligent one of his
own.  Katu is the solitary gorilla in the zoo's collection since his mate
Nalaga died a year ago.  Now poor Katu sits alone waiting for someone to
visit him.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote beats his barrel chest proudly.;%10 emote closes his eyes and
 smiles as he remembers his mate.;%10 emote likes bananas, but only the
 ones from Africa!

Mobs.Name: siamang gibbon female mother
Mobs.LongDescription: A female siamang gibbon swings through the trees.
Mobs.Description:
The female siamang gibbon swings through the trees with her long sinewy
arms.  She has a powerful grip, and even when she is barely balanced, she
manages not to fall from her arboreal perch.  The siamang has a large
black pouch on her throat which she uses to create the eerie call distinct
to her species.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote emits an eerie call to her mate.;%10 emote swings through the
 trees with the greatest of ease.

Mobs.Name: male siamang gibbon
Mobs.LongDescription: A male siamang gibbon sits in a tree calling to his mate.
Mobs.Description:
The male siamang is only slightly larger than his female mate.  He has the
characteristic large throat sac by which he creates his eerie whooping
call.  He flies easily through the tree-tops of his enclosure.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 emote grabs a branch and takes off swinging.;%10 emote throws his
head back and starts to whooop whoooop whooooop whoooooop!

Mobs.Name: baby siamang gibbon
Mobs.LongDescription: A baby siamang gibbon is standing here sucking his thumb.
Mobs.Description:
The baby siamang is very cute indeed.  He has a tiny little face, and you
can't help but laugh when you watch him try to walk.  His arms are too
long for his body, so he holds them in the air above his head.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote gives up trying to walk and just sits down to pout.

Mobs.Name: young siamang gibbon
Mobs.LongDescription: A young siamang chases his brother around.
Mobs.Description:
The young siamang is quite a sight as he zips through the trees chasing
his younger brother around.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 tickle baby;%10 taunt baby

Mobs.Name: komodo dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A large komodo dragon lumbers toward you in search of a meal.
Mobs.Description:
You think you are lucky that this dragon only eats carrion??  Maybe not! 
His bite is so deadly that he will kill you within minutes.  Then once you
are dead, he will eat you at his leisure!

Mobs.Name: gila monster
Mobs.LongDescription: A colorful gila monster basks in the sunlight.
Mobs.Description:
The colorful gila monster appears to be sluggish, but don't turn your back
on him as he will attack you and kill you with his poisonous bite!

Mobs.Name: mata turtle matamata
Mobs.LongDescription: A large mata mata floats stealthily beneath the surface of the water.
Mobs.Description:
At first glance, the mata mata appears to be a large pile of leaves below
the surface of the water, but as you peer closer a small head shoots out
from beneath the strange turtle's shell.  The mata mata uses camoflauge
and lightning reflexes to capture his aquatic prey.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote snaps his head out from under his shell and grabs a fish.

Mobs.Name: peacock bird colorful
Mobs.LongDescription: A colorful peacock shows off his beautiful tail.
Mobs.Description:
The peacock uses his lovely tail to attract his less colorful mate, the
peahen.  His glorious tail has been used as decoration for centuries. 
Maybe one of his feathers will look nice in your cap!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 strut

Mobs.Name: kiwi bird
Mobs.LongDescription: A fuzzy brown bird walks around here because he has no wings!
Mobs.Description:
The fuzzy brown kiwi is one of the few wingless birds.  He prefers the
darkness of night, and can seldom be seen anywhere else.

Mobs.Name: pygmy marmoset young
Mobs.LongDescription: A young pygmy marmoset swings from a branch here.
Mobs.Description:
The pygmy marmoset peers down at you from his perch.  He is rather shy, so
you might have to lure him down here with a piece of candy.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote peeks out shyly from his perch.

Mobs.Name: female pygmy marmoset
Mobs.LongDescription: A young female marmoset peers at you with cautious eyes.
Mobs.Description:
The shy marmoset cowers as you try to get a closer look.  She doesn't
trust you very much, and she shakes with fear as you approach.

Mobs.Name: marmoset male pygmy
Mobs.LongDescription: A male marmoset cautiously approaches you.
Mobs.Description:
This bold male marmoset is actually very afraid right now.  He is only
approaching you because he must defend his territory, which you appear to
be in right now.

Mobs.Name: golden lion male tamarin
Mobs.LongDescription: A male golden lion tamarin screeches fiercely at you as you enter his territory.
Mobs.Description:
The male tamarin is generally a shy creature, but if you threaten his
territory, he will attempt to chase you away.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote screeches fiercely!

Mobs.Name: golden lion female tamarin
Mobs.LongDescription: A female golden lion tamarin hides in her tree-top nest.
Mobs.Description:
The tamarin female is more cautious than her male mate.  She gazes at you
cautiously from the relative safety of her tree-top nest.

Mobs.Name: lion
Mobs.LongDescription: A fierce lion roars as he attacks you!
Mobs.Description:
The mighty lion is rather stupendous with his glorious mane and proud
stature.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 roars loudly!;%10 purr

Mobs.Name: tiger
Mobs.LongDescription: A vicious tiger surprises you as he attacks from behind.
Mobs.Description:
The magnificent tiger is covered with the characteristic black and orange
strips.  His large claws are indeed as fearsome as his long sharp teeth.

Mobs.Name: zoo director
Mobs.LongDescription: The Zoo Director stands here waiting to tell you all about the zoo.
Mobs.Description:
The Zoo Director is so full of information!  If you stand around long
enough, he will tell you all about the New Mavernal Zoo and the
surrounding areas.  You can even ask him how to get to any of the exhibits
in the zoo!
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 'I like bananas, but only the ones from Africa!;%5 'If you'd like to 
find your way to any of the exhibits, check out the map in the map room or 
get your own from one of our Information Aides!;%5 'Be sure to visit Katu, 
he gets so lonely sometimes.;%5 smile;%5 'Welcome to the Newbie Zoo!

Mobs.Name: groundskeeper gardener
Mobs.LongDescription: A groundskeeper is planting some flowers to brighten up the zoo.
Mobs.Description:
The groundskeeper's hands are covered with dirt, and he smells of
fertilizer.  He does his best to keep the zoo looking great!

Mobs.Name: groundskeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: A groundskeeper is here trying to keep the zoo clean.
Mobs.Description:
The groundskeeper is always walking around picking up after people.  He
does his best to keep the zoo looking nice.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 grumble;%10 glare

Mobs.Name: sisaly information aide
Mobs.LongDescription: Sisaly the Information aide is here to help you.
Mobs.Description:
Sisaly the Information Aide is a helpful young lady.  She will provide you
with maps, brochures, and various other bits of information!

Mobs.Name: salesman souveneir
Mobs.LongDescription: A young man stands here waiting to assist you with your purchases.
Mobs.Description:
This helpful young man is here to help you with your souveneir purchases. 
Simply <list> then <buy item> to get him to help!

Mobs.Name: snack shop employee lady
Mobs.LongDescription: A helpful young lady stands here watching over the Snack Shop.
Mobs.Description:
This helpful young lady keeps the counter of the snack shop stocked so you
can find something to eat and drink in the New Mavernal Zoo.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote tries to look busy in case her boss walks in.

Mobs.Name: boy
Mobs.LongDescription: A little boy is wandering around looking at the animals.
Mobs.Description:
This young man has his eyes filled with awe as he looks at the many
animals found in the New Mavernal Zoo.

Mobs.Name: girl
Mobs.LongDescription: A little girl looks at you with wonder.
Mobs.Description:
The little girl doesn't seem sure if you are a part of the exhibit or a
visitor like her...
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote stares in awe.

Mobs.Name: mom mother woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A lovely woman wanders around the zoo.
Mobs.Description:
This lovely young woman seems to have lost her son.  She is wandering
around calling his name...
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 'Bart!  Where are you?;%10 'Have you seen my son?

Mobs.Name: dad father man
Mobs.LongDescription: A young man is wandering around calling for his wife.
Mobs.Description: This young man seems to have misplaced his whole family!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 grumble;%10 'Where could they have gone?;%10 sigh

Mobs.Name: titi monkey
Mobs.LongDescription: A titi monkey sits in the tree.
Mobs.Description:
The titi monkey has golden fur and a long fuzzy tail.  He sits high up in
the tree-tops gazing down at you.

Mobs.Name: tucker orang orangutan
Mobs.LongDescription: A silly young orangutan is doing flips across the room.
Mobs.Description:
Tucker is a young orangutan, still small and silly.  He is playful, and he
tries to entice you into a game of fetch.  You soon realize it is YOU who
is doing the fetching!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 wiggle;%10 grin;%10 giggle;%10 stare

Mobs.Name: darwin information aide info
Mobs.LongDescription: Darwin the Information Aide is here to help you.
Mobs.Description:
Darwin knows all kinds of facts about the many animals in the zoo.  He can
help you find your way around and provide you with various maps.

Mobs.Name: trainer instructor newbie guildmaster
Mobs.LongDescription: A wise man stands here to train all newbies.
Mobs.Description:
This wise man will train you with your skills.  He is learned in all of
the classes of skills.  This wise instructor is brought to you by a grant
from the Save the Newbies Foundation.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 'Tell me "practice" and let me teach you something!"

Mobs.Name: medic newbie healer
Mobs.LongDescription: The Newbie Zoo Medic is here to help you when you need it.
Mobs.Description:
This lady is a skilled professional.  She is learned in the ways of magic
and healing.  She will gladly clean your wounds if you let her.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 'I can't wait til I get licensed so I can actually help you!

Mobs.Name: salesman souvenir man young
Mobs.LongDescription: A young man stands here waiting to assist you with your purchases.
Mobs.Description:
This helpful young man is here to help you with your souveneir purchases. 
Simply <list> then <buy item> to get him to help!

Mobs.Name: penguin escapee bird escaped
Mobs.LongDescription: A penguin tries to look inconspicuous as she tries to escape the zoo.
Mobs.Description:
This little penguin managed to somehow escape from the bird house!  She's
on the run now and doesn't want to go back!
